note: Asset register. Nothing is used in the deck until status is 'authorised' and every field for its type is filled. Evidence first: licence_url must be a page that states the licence; retrieved_on is the date it was read. Screenshots need environment, masking and who authorised them.

policy_proposed.people: No image may be captioned or described as a ScholarClone customer. Photos with identifiable people are labelled 'illustrative stock imagery' in the credits.
policy_proposed.ai_images: Not authorised. Used only if the owner says yes in writing; then generated_by_ai is true and the credit line says so.
